tw-wi-dickeyville-may-cache-1897.t: The $40-50,000 'dog find' of Oct 1897 was denied a week later by the Cuba City News; a local denial does not settle it.

tw-blackburn-gordon-1897.t: The papers say the killer took $500-1,200 from the bedding and the rest of the fortune (about $75,000) sat in Stillwater and St. Paul banks; no dig was reported to 1902.

t-hermit-island.t: The only contemporary item (Beaver Dam Argus 13 Nov 1890 p1) says the hermit died in 1866 and mentions no money; the coin story comes from Burnham and the WPA guide.

cr-lemuel-hill-hoard-1906.st: Jars holding $3,500 were found in the granary wheat; whether gold remained was 'still a question' in Jan 1907; no later find.

set.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): local Winona Daily News probate plus the Minneapolis Journal

tw-randall-north-bend-1901.t: Wire story only (eight Wisconsin copies, 30 Oct-9 Nov 1901); no estate notice or find; Jackson County papers are not indexed.
src: Milwaukee Daily News, 30 Oct 1901, p. 8, 'Say He Owned $500,000' (Newspapers.com 1298983846)

tw-il-marcus-train-robbery-1902.st: The arrests wire says the gang crossed by skiff into Iowa and buried the plunder there, said to be $3,200 in currency; several half-dollars dropped in flight were found in the sand, and the sunk skiff was found. Amounts conflict ($2,200, $3,200, $20-30,000).
tw-il-marcus-train-robbery-1902.t: Amount conflicts: $2,200 (Inter Ocean) vs $20-30,000 (Leader); half-dollars were found in the sand where the boat sank.
src: Baltimore Sun, 10 Jan 1903, p. 8 (arrests wire; Newspapers.com 371074175)

tw-mi-north-manitou-chicago-fire-gold.t: Earliest print is a 1940 AP round-up with the same wording; no Leelanau paper or earlier telling found.
src: Council Bluffs Daily Nonpareil, 7 Jan 1940, p. 20 (AP round-up; Newspapers.com 960525835)
